nodes.label: BaseSourceAdapter
nodes.rationale: Swappable extraction seam so a T5 model or an LLM can replace GDELT without touching storage, API or UI.

nodes.label: No-location conflicts
nodes.rationale: Conflicts whose events GDELT could not geocode are surfaced in a sidebar panel and fixed only by explicit human action; coordinates are never guessed, re-geocoded or auto-placed.

nodes.label: Confidence score
nodes.rationale: Ordinal corroboration score blending NumArticles with NumSources; absolute scale unvalidated, so gate decisions use the raw counts (sources >= 2 and articles >= 3) rather than thresholding the score.

nodes.label: Proximity grouping rule
nodes.rationale: Replaced keyword matching because matching the country word merged every Yemen event into one conflict; rule is same country + within 100 km of anchor + a 14-day gap-since-last-event window (not total duration).
